text: Finally! I've been looking for an app like this for YEARS. Something to help me stay on task, with routines that can be repeated daily. I needed structure, simplicity & consistency to help me with distractibility. This app truly delivers, so as a therapist I might recommend this to clients if it works out. Well done. If I were to add one more feature, it would be voice prompts. So during each task, you'd also have a voice reminding you of the task at intervals of your choice (e.g. every minute)
author: Irene Cassar
developer_reply:
Thank you so much for the review! I'm so glad you finally found the app you've been looking for. Hearing that it helps with your distractibility and gives you that daily structure is exactly why we made it.
The voice prompt idea is actually quite good, we'll definitely add that to the list for future updates! Thanks again for the support.

author: Donielle
developer_reply:
Thank you for the review, Donielle! We appreciate you trying OneFlow and tracking our progress. Your feedback is incredibly helpful for us, and we're always looking to improve, so please share any other ideas with us at oneflow@m-o-n-o.co.
We hope OneFlow grows into an even better routine planner for you!
